scenarios.title: Active controller owns the simulated field
scenarios.expected: ctrl-a reports role active and its monitor serves a telemetry snapshot

scenarios.title: Standby converges behind the active
scenarios.expected: ctrl-b reports role standby with tracking converged within 60 s
observations: ctrl-b reported role=standby but tracking stayed 'diverged' for the full 60 s window
checkpoint pulls returned 200 throughout; convergence never declared
scenarios.detail: Reproducible on this revision; candidate product defect in standby convergence.

scenarios.title: Writable point command applies at a scan boundary
scenarios.expected: POST /command marking pump-1 out-of-service is accepted and visible in telemetry
observations: not executed: scenario depends on a converged standby topology per run order

scenarios.title: Demote/promote switchover preserves the field
scenarios.expected: POST /demote on ctrl-a then POST /promote on ctrl-b leaves ctrl-b active
observations: not executed: skipped after standby-tracking failure

capability_limitations.detail: Controller has no EtherCAT driver; all field I/O exercised through the dcs-sim-net remote simulation only.
